notes: «حدثنا أبي» names the compiler's father only by relation: a relation link.
«يرفع الحديث» is a gap: the chain is raised to an unnamed source, written in its place as unnamed (rule 8). The saying is that source's words.
«مصنف هذا الكتاب أدام الله عزه ... يعني بذلك ...» is the compiler's own gloss, not a link. «2-38» is the report number.
